description: Sign-in, MFA, PAM, and identity governance for all 45,000 workforce users, including the government-community tenant for FFE users
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Every division system federates to SYS-G1; without sign-in no order can be taken, picked, or shipped
manual_workaround: Sealed break-glass accounts per critical system; cached handheld sessions continue for one shift
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Used by every process below

business_process: Cloud landing zones, hub network, and keys
description: Network hubs, guardrails, key management, and logging on provider A (commercial) and provider B (government-community and backup vault)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: The WMS, TMS, storefront, data platform, and FFE all run behind the hubs
manual_workaround: Provider-native failover between availability zones; FFE runs in a separate landing zone
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: WMS (Logistics), storefront (Online Retail), FFE (IT Distribution)

description: Links from 9 DCs, 2 integration centers, the contact center hubs, and offices
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: DCs cannot reach the cloud-hosted WMS without connectivity; one DC day is about 23,000 shipments
manual_workaround: Dual carriers at every DC; cellular failover for handheld gateways
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: All DCs (Logistics); integration centers (IT Distribution); contact center (Online Retail)

description: Orders, credit, purchasing, inventory, invoicing, and payments for all three divisions in SYS-G4
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $49 million of group revenue per day flows through the ERP; most is delayed rather than lost for the first half day
manual_workaround: Order capture continues in the portal and storefront queues; DCs ship released waves already in the WMS
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Every division; feeds WMS waves (Logistics) and storefront order status (Online Retail)

description: Consumer browsing, cart, checkout, and order status on the website and app
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $11 million revenue per day; consumers buy elsewhere during an outage, so revenue is lost, not delayed
manual_workaround: Maintenance page with phone ordering for high-value orders; app shows cached catalog
dependent_third_parties: Commerce platform vendor; content delivery network; payment service provider
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: SYS-G1 sign-in for staff; ERP order hand-off; WMS fulfillment (Logistics)

description: Card authorization through the payment service provider hosted fields and the contact center virtual terminal
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: No authorization means no order; the PSP holds transaction records, so data loss on the group side is limited
manual_workaround: Secondary PSP route for the storefront (configured, not tested); phone orders held for call-back
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: None beyond SYS-G3 hubs

description: Wave release, picking, packing, labeling, and dispatch at 9 DCs through the WMS and 6,800 handhelds
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Carrier cut-off times; 3PL client service levels; DoD delivery dates for integration jobs
manual_workaround: Paper pick lists from the last wave extract; manual labels from the carrier portal (about 20% of normal volume)
dependent_third_parties: WMS vendor support; parcel and LTL carriers
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Fulfills IT Distribution and Online Retail orders; depends on ERP waves (BP-G05) and SYS-G1

business_process: Order capture: reseller portal, EDI, and quoting
description: Reseller orders, quotes, and EDI purchase orders from about 19,000 accounts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $34.5 million revenue per day; large resellers move volume to competitors after about a day
manual_workaround: Inside sales take orders by phone and email into the ERP
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: ERP (BP-G05); EDI hub (BP-G06)

description: Value-added network, B2B APIs, supplier portal, advance ship notices, and catalog feeds for about 1,150 trading partners
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Large resellers and suppliers transact only by EDI; advance ship notices drive DC receiving
manual_workaround: Trading partners resend files after recovery; urgent orders by email
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Order capture (IT Distribution); receiving (Logistics); supplier catalog (Online Retail)

description: 24x7 SOC, SIEM, and EDR; incident handling and evidence
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Notice clocks (DFARS 252.204-7012(c) 72 hours; Form 8-K Item 1.05) keep running during a SOC outage
manual_workaround: Retainer firm tooling; EDR console reachable from provider B
dependent_third_parties: SIEM and EDR vendors; forensic retainer
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Every division depends on the SOC for detection and incident facts

description: Conveyors, sortation, and automated storage and retrieval at 9 DCs
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Automated DCs ship 60% to 80% of volume through sortation; unsafe restarts can injure workers
manual_workaround: Manual sortation lanes at reduced throughput; lockout before any restart
dependent_third_parties: Automation vendors (3); PLC spare parts suppliers
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: WMS (BP-LW02) sends sort instructions; no IT Distribution or Online Retail fallback exists for automated DCs

description: Dock receiving, OEM serial validation, authenticity checks, and putaway for all divisions and 3PL clients
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Inbound trucks queue at docks; authenticity checks prevent tampered or counterfeit stock entering every division (P08)
manual_workaround: Hold inbound in yard trailers; receive to quarantine with paper logs
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Advance ship notices from the EDI hub (BP-G06); quarantine decisions by IT Distribution supply chain risk

description: Load planning, carrier tendering, private fleet dispatch, and tracking
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Missed carrier pickups and fleet routes; electronic logging device records for drivers
manual_workaround: Phone tendering with core carriers; paper dispatch sheets
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Ships for all divisions and 3PL clients

description: Inventory, order, and billing services for about 140 external 3PL clients, including the WMS client web console
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Contract service levels and service credits; clients rely on the WMS inventory record for their own books (SOC 1 report)
manual_workaround: Client orders by file transfer; manual inventory reports
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Shares the WMS and DCs with group fulfillment

description: DoD orders, CUI configuration documents, staging, imaging, and configuration at IC-1 and IC-2
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Installation schedules for DoD sites; DFARS reporting and CUI safeguarding; prime relationships worth about $570 million a year
manual_workaround: Pause integration jobs; hold CUI in the FFE; confirm schedules with primes
dependent_third_parties: Primes A to F; OEM firmware portals
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: SYS-G1 government-community tenant; DC buildings and badge systems run by Logistics; WMS shipping (BP-LW02)

business_process: Purchasing, supplier management, and automated reordering
description: Purchase orders to about 2,400 suppliers, including AI-001 forecasts and automatic release
process_owner: IT Distribution vice president of purchasing
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Stock positions cover about 3 weeks for A-class SKUs; federal orders need authorized sources
manual_workaround: Buyers place purchase orders manually from ERP reorder reports
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Group data platform (SYS-G6); EDI hub (BP-G06); Online Retail buys through the same purchasing team

description: Service calls, phone orders keyed into the virtual terminal, and returns authorizations
process_owner: Online Retail vice president of customer care
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 6% of orders and most complaints arrive by phone; social media escalation
manual_workaround: Callback queue; email and chat handled by agents on standby
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: SYS-G1 sign-in; ERP order status (BP-G05)

description: Automated screening of orders before release, with analyst review queues
process_owner: Online Retail director of fraud prevention
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Orders can be held for a day; chargebacks rise if released unscreened
manual_workaround: Hold high-value orders for manual review; release low-risk orders under rules
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Group data platform models (SYS-G6)

description: Manufacturer-of-record checks, covered-manufacturer blocks, and denied-party screening for federal and export orders
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Federal orders must not ship covered equipment (FAR 52.204-25(b)); exports need screening
manual_workaround: Hold all federal and export orders until screening returns
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Group trade compliance; Online Retail marketplace has no equivalent check (gap 2)

description: Seller onboarding and verification, listings, counterfeit takedowns, and payouts for 2,600 sellers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: INFORM Consumers Act verification and suspension windows of 10 days; seller payout schedules
manual_workaround: Pause new seller onboarding; delay payouts by one cycle
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: SYS-G1; group data platform for seller risk scores

description: Importer-of-record data, broker instructions, and entry documents for direct imports
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Containers wait at ports and accrue fees; broker filings continue on paper instructions
manual_workaround: Brokers file from emailed commercial invoices
dependent_third_parties: Licensed customs brokers; ocean and air carriers
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Purchasing (IT Distribution, Online Retail)

description: Asset tagging, staging, chain of custody, and media sanitization for about 300 enterprise customers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customer contract deadlines; sanitization certificates must match chain of custody
manual_workaround: Hold devices in secure cages; paper chain-of-custody forms
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: DC space and security from Logistics

description: Close, consolidation, and SEC filings, including Form 8-K Item 1.05 support
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Filing deadlines; disclosure controls
manual_workaround: Extend close calendar; manual consolidation workbooks
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Every division reports through the ERP

description: Consumer returns, grading, data wiping, and certified refurbished listings
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Returns can queue for days without loss
manual_workaround: Returns held at DCs until systems recover
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: DC space and receiving from Logistics; Lifecycle Services sanitization method

description: Payroll, time capture, and HR records for 45,000 employees
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Pay dates; DC hourly time capture
manual_workaround: Repeat last payroll with adjustments
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Every division; joiner and leaver events feed SYS-G1

description: Vendor price files, special pricing agreements, and rebate claims
process_owner: IT Distribution vice president of vendor programs
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Rebate claims have 30 to 90 day windows
manual_workaround: Use last loaded price files; claim later
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: EDI hub price files (BP-G06)
